info.title: Tiducto Transit API — Places
info.description: Place search over the environment's service area (stops, addresses, municipalities and points of interest), key-authenticated. Companion to routing, stops and realtime; the four share one pack version. A member that has no value is absent, never null. `type` is an open set: new values may be added, and a client ignores a type it does not know. A stop's `id` is the value routing's `stopLocation.stopLocationId` takes, and a stop carries the members of its stop search hit under the same names, `_geoDistance` excepted (here `distance`). `wheelchairBoarding` is the feed's GTFS integer code, and an unrecognised code passes through unchanged. Addresses and municipalities are from RÚIAN, the Czech register of addresses and territorial units (© ČÚZK, CC BY 4.0); points of interest are from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); results carry those attribution obligations. A query parameter not listed is a 400 `<name> is not allowed`, and a repeated one a 400 `<name> is invalid`. A method an operation doesn't take is a 405 `method_not_allowed`. A path that matches no operation, and every path of an environment without places search, is the gateway's plain-text `404 Not Found`, outside every operation.

servers.description: Your environment. Replace `{env-slug}` with your environment's slug.

get.description:
Place search over the environment's service area: stops, addresses, municipalities and points of interest.
- `q` and `limit` are required; absent is a 400 `<name> is required`, and `q` empty after trimming whitespace is `q is required`.
- `q` is 2 to 100 characters after trimming whitespace; shorter or longer is a 400 `q is out of range`.
- `limit` is an integer from 1 to 20; not an integer is a 400 `limit is invalid`, outside 1 to 20 `limit is out of range`. Nothing is clamped.
- `latitude` and `longitude` are optional, both or neither, in WGS84 degrees; one without the other is a 400 naming the absent one `<name> is required`, not a decimal `<name> is invalid`, and outside -90 to 90 or -180 to 180 `<name> is out of range`.
- At most `limit` hits, best first: stops, then municipalities and landmarks, then other points of interest and addresses. With `latitude` and `longitude` the nearest of equally good matches comes first and each hit carries `distance` in metres; without them distance plays no part.
- Hits come only from the environment's service area.
- A `q` with a digit lists individual addresses; without one, none.
- Abbreviated and spelled-out forms find each other (`žel. st.` and `železniční stanice`), and text without diacritics matches text with them.
- A stop's `id` is its feed-prefixed id, the value routing's `stopLocation.stopLocationId` takes; any other `id` is opaque.
- A stop carries the members of its stop search hit under the same names, `_geoDistance` excepted (here `distance`): `gtfsId`, `code`, `wheelchairBoarding` and `modes` included, a station's platforms folded into it. Other types carry none of those four.
- The response echoes the `q` searched as `query`, without its leading and trailing whitespace.
- Addresses and municipalities are from RÚIAN, the Czech register of addresses and territorial units (© ČÚZK, CC BY 4.0); points of interest are from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Results carry those attribution obligations.
- A member that has no value is absent from a hit, never null.
- A query parameter not listed is a 400 `<name> is not allowed`, and a repeated one a 400 `<name> is invalid`. Another method is a 405 `method_not_allowed`.
- The response carries `ETag`, `Cache-Control: private, max-age=300` and `Vary: apikey`; a request whose `If-None-Match` matches the `ETag` (RFC 9110 weak comparison) is a 304 without a body.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text, 2 to 100 characters after trimming whitespace. Abbreviated and spelled-out forms find each other, and text without diacritics matches. With a digit, individual addresses are listed; without one, none are. Absent or empty after trimming is a 400 `q is required`, and shorter or longer `q is out of range`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max hits to return, an integer from 1 to 20. Absent is a 400 `limit is required`, not an integer `limit is invalid`, and outside 1 to 20 `limit is out of range`; rejected, never clamped.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude in degrees, -90 to 90, with `longitude` or not at all; with both, a nearer hit ranks above an equally good farther one of the same kind and each hit carries `distance`. Present without `longitude` is a 400 `longitude is required`; not a decimal is `latitude is invalid`, and outside -90 to 90 `latitude is out of range`.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude in degrees, -180 to 180, with `latitude` or not at all. Present without `latitude` is a 400 `latitude is required`; not a decimal is `longitude is invalid`, and outside -180 to 180 `longitude is out of range`.

200.description: At most `limit` hits, best first. A better text match ranks higher; among equally good matches, stops come before other places. With `latitude` and `longitude`, the nearer of two equally good matches of the same kind comes first (distance is not compared between a stop and another place); without them, municipalities and landmarks come before other points of interest and addresses; addresses only when `q` holds a house number. Hits come only from the environment's service area.

Vary.description: `apikey`: a private cache keys the response by host, URL and `apikey`.

304.description: The result is unchanged: `If-None-Match` matches the current `ETag` under RFC 9110 weak comparison (`W/` tags, lists and `*` included). No body; `ETag`, `Cache-Control` and `Vary` as on a 200.

Vary.description: `apikey`: a private cache keys the response by host, URL and `apikey`.

400.description: `q` or `limit` absent is `<name> is required`, and so is `q` empty after trimming; `q` shorter than 2 or longer than 100 characters is `q is out of range`; `limit` not an integer is `limit is invalid`, and outside 1 to 20 `limit is out of range`. `latitude` or `longitude` without the other is `<name> is required`, naming the absent one; not a decimal is `<name> is invalid`, and outside its range `<name> is out of range`. A query parameter not listed is `<name> is not allowed`, and a repeated one `<name> is invalid`; `field` names it.

401.description: The `apikey` header is missing (`key_missing`) or holds no valid key (`key_invalid`).

403.description: The key is not allowed on this operation (`key_not_allowed`), or the agreement it belongs to is inactive (`agreement_inactive`).

429.description: The key's rate limit is reached (`rate_limited`).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is admitted again.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make per rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix seconds at which the rate-limit window resets.

4XX.description: Another client error: 404 `not_found`, 405 `method_not_allowed`, 411 `length_required` (a body without a length) or 413 `payload_too_large`.

5XX.description: From Spider, an ErrorResponse: `internal_error`, `upstream_unavailable` or `upstream_timeout`. A network intermediary in front of Spider may answer a 5XX with a body that is not JSON.

apikey.name: apikey
apikey.description: The raw key in an `apikey` header (not Authorization: Bearer).

PlaceSearchResponse.description: Search hits, at most `limit`, best first.

query.description: The `q` searched, without its leading and trailing whitespace.

PlaceHit.description: One place. A member that has no value is absent, never null. A `stop` carries the members of its `StopHit` from stop search under the same names and with the same values, `_geoDistance` excepted (here `distance`); `gtfsId`, `code`, `wheelchairBoarding` and `modes` appear only on a stop, a station's platforms folded into it. `country`, `region`, `district`, `city` and `suburb` are the admin areas the place lies in, derived the same way as a `StopHit`'s, so every hit is labelled alike.

id.description: For a `stop`, the stop's feed-prefixed id (`<feedId>:<id>`), the value routing's `stopLocation.stopLocationId` takes. For any other type, an opaque id, stable across searches.

type.description: What the place is: `stop`, `address`, `place` (a municipality) or `poi` (a point of interest). New values may be added; a client ignores a type it does not know.

gtfsId.description: A `stop`'s feed-prefixed id (`<feedId>:<id>`), the same id routing's `gtfsId` carries and stop search returns; equal to the hit's `id`. Absent for other types.

name.description: Display name; a stop's is the operator's own.

code.description: A `stop`'s short public code riders know it by, as the feed gives it (GTFS `stop_code`), e.g. the one printed on its sign. Absent when the feed doesn't provide it, and for other types.

wheelchairBoarding.description: A `stop`'s GTFS `wheelchair_boarding`: `1` some vehicles here can be boarded by a rider in a wheelchair, `2` wheelchair boarding isn't possible here, `0` no information. A station's value is the station's own; its platforms' values aren't combined into it. Absent when the feed doesn't set it, which also means no information, and for other types. Any other value is passed through from the feed unchanged.

modes.description: Modes of the routes serving a `stop`, each once, as the mode names routing returns for those routes (e.g. `BUS`, `TRAM`, `RAIL`), ordered by scheduled calls at the stop, most first, ties by name. A station's modes cover all its platforms. Absent when no route serves the stop, and for other types.

category.description: What kind of place it is: for a `poi` e.g. `university`, `hospital`, `mall`, `cemetery`; for a `place` `municipality`; for an `address` `building`, or `recreational` for a recreational building. Absent for a stop. New values may be added.

distance.description: Metres from `latitude`/`longitude`; present only when they were sent.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body: a stable machine-readable `code`, which names a state, and a human-readable `message`.

code.description: One of `bad_request`, `key_missing`, `key_invalid`, `key_not_allowed`, `agreement_inactive`, `planning_limit_reached`, `not_found`, `method_not_allowed`, `length_required`, `payload_too_large`, `rate_limited`, `internal_error`, `upstream_unavailable`, `upstream_timeout`. New codes may be added.

message.description: For `bad_request`: `<field> is required|invalid|out of range|not allowed`, or `body is invalid` when the body is empty, not JSON or not an object.

field.description: Present only on a 400 that names one member: its dot path from the body root, array positions omitted, or the query parameter's name.
